query: GET https://arxiv.org/e-print/2202.04937 (Xu et al. 2022, SDSS-IV MaNGA: spatially resolved properties of kinematically misaligned galaxies); verbatim transcription of the table in archive member sections/2-data.tex, pulled into the main paper.tex via \input{}
measurement_or_model: MEASUREMENT. Counts of MaNGA galaxies classified aligned vs kinematically misaligned from the measured stellar and ionised-gas velocity fields. SF/GV/QS is a star-formation-rate classification. No DM halo, no Jeans/JAM model.
note: AGGREGATE COUNTS ONLY - Xu et al. 2022 publishes NO per-galaxy list of its misaligned galaxies in the arXiv source and has no VizieR catalogue. Misaligned total = 72+142+242 = 456 out of 6958 MaNGA galaxies (6.6 per cent). This 456-galaxy misaligned sample is the same one used by Zhou et al. 2022 (MNRAS 515, 5081), which also publishes no per-galaxy list. EXTRACTION GUARD: the table lives in a sections/ subdirectory member and is \input{} into the main tex - parsing only paper.tex would have silently found ZERO tables.
